about.title: About Sweetwater UHSD
about.content: Sweetwater Union High School District serves middle and high school students in the South Bay area of San Diego County. The 7-12 student calendar is the main planning source for first day and school year end dates, semester dates, fall break, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, legal holidays, declared holidays, non-instructional days, AP testing windows, and professional development days.

about.title: How to Use This Sweetwater UHSD Calendar
about.content: Use this page for the regular Sweetwater UHSD 7-12 student calendar, then confirm campus-specific events, athletics, testing, graduation details, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements through Sweetwater UHSD or your student's school. Students following the OSS MCHS calendar should check the separate OSS MCHS PDF.

customSections.label: Sweetwater UHSD Local Calendar Context
customSections.content: Sweetwater UHSD calendar planning is especially important for San Diego South Bay families because the district serves grades 7-12 and publishes detailed student calendars with fall, winter, and spring breaks. Because Sweetwater serves South Bay communities, families often coordinate school breaks with San Diego County travel periods, childcare coverage, campus activities, and high school testing windows. Families should also check alternate program calendars, such as OSS MCHS, when their student follows a non-regular 7-12 schedule.

planningTips.title: Sweetwater UHSD Calendar Usage Tips
content: Use the regular 7-12 student calendar PDF for districtwide student dates, breaks, holidays, semester dates, and non-instructional days.
Check the OSS MCHS calendar separately if your student follows that alternate schedule.
Use campus announcements for bell schedules, testing, athletics, graduation details, and same-day changes because those items may not appear on the districtwide student calendar.
Use the PDF for official review and the ICS file for a one-time personal calendar import.

districtFaqs.q: Does Sweetwater UHSD publish a separate OSS MCHS calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. For 2026-2027, Sweetwater UHSD publishes a separate OSS MCHS Student Calendar in addition to the regular 7-12 student calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Sweetwater UHSD calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Sweetwater UHSD student calendars page and campus announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Sweetwater UHSD.
